title: A webhook request with a valid signature reaches the downstream handler; a mismatched signature is refused
asA: operator whose project accepts webhook posts from the provider
iWant: the verifier to gate downstream delivery on a constant-time signature check
soThat: fabricated delivery events cannot corrupt the project's event stream

acceptanceCriteria.description: A webhook POST whose signature header matches the expected signature computed from the request body, the timestamp header, and the configured signing secret reaches the downstream handler; the verifier returns HTTP 200 and the handler observes the parsed event exactly once.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running project with a downstream handler that counts invocations, a configured signing secret, and a POST whose signature header carries the signature the verifier computes
acceptanceCriteria.when: the POST is delivered to the webhook route
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response status is 200, the handler invocation counter increments by exactly one, and the parsed event delivered to the handler matches the POST body

acceptanceCriteria.description: A webhook POST whose signature header does not match the expected signature is refused with HTTP 401 and an empty body; the downstream handler is not invoked and a `webhookVerificationFailed` audit event is emitted.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running project instrumented to observe the audit sink and a POST whose signature header carries a mismatched value
acceptanceCriteria.when: the POST is delivered to the webhook route
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response status is 401, the response body is empty, the handler invocation counter is unchanged, and the audit sink observes exactly one `webhookVerificationFailed` event

acceptanceCriteria.description: The signing secret does not appear on the response body, on any log line the verifier writes during the call, or on any exception the verifier throws during the call.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running project instrumented to capture the verifier's log stream and any thrown exceptions, and a distinctive signing secret the test can byte-scan for
acceptanceCriteria.when: a mix of matched and mismatched webhook posts is delivered
acceptanceCriteria.then: no captured response body, log line, or exception message contains the distinctive signing secret substring
